gloss: just as you say; exactly right

definitions.gloss: just as you say; exactly as you say; you're absolutely right
definitions.explanation: A polite expression used to agree wholeheartedly with what someone has said. The respectful form of その{通|とお}り.

examples.japanese: {仰|おっしゃ}る{通|とお}りです。
⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仰|おっしゃ}る{通|とお}り、⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: Just as the teacher says, more practice is needed.

examples.japanese: {仰|おっしゃ}る{通|とお}り、⟦{現状|げんじょう}→現状：02721_genjou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}しません→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: As you rightly point out, the problem won't be solved if things stay as they are.

notes:
USAGE:
A highly polite expression of agreement, appropriate in business meetings, formal conversations, and when speaking to superiors. {仰|おっしゃ}る is the honorific form of ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧.

FORMALITY SCALE:
- ⟦その{通|とお}り→その通り：22252_sonotoori⟧ (neutral)
- ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ (casual)
- ⟦おっしゃる→おっしゃる：01299_ossharu⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ (formal/honorific)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦その{通|とお}り→その通り：22252_sonotoori⟧: that's right — neutral level of agreement
- ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧: exactly — emphasizes precision of the point
